description: Implementer for the issue-resolution desk. Runs as Claude Code on the shared workflow sandbox: follows the advisor's .desk/plan.md, first checks whether an open PR already resolves the issue — pushing its update onto that existing PR's branch and closing redundant duplicates instead of opening a competing one — otherwise fixes the issue on a tale/<id> branch, runs the tests, waits for CI, and summarizes the change. Cannot mark a task done — a human gate does that.

env.description: The BYO credential Claude Code authenticates with (your Anthropic or Anthropic-compatible API key).
